text:
janet_mktg: Hey runtime folks we're finalizing the webinar deck and need a tight data handoff for a small benchmark blurb + an interactive demo. Two quick asks: 1) verify per-token cost and p95 coldstart for rwd-gen4-small-quant vs rwd-gen4-small-fp16 for single-request UX; 2) give a tiny reproducible package we can run during the live demo (local docker or laptop-friendly). Also: include a one-line caveat we can put next to the metric.

ali_bench: Can do. For clarity: measure batch=1, concurrency=1, payloads <=128 tokens, region us-west1 (hosted). We should report p50/p95 latencies, tokens/sec cost, and a per-1k-token $ cost for both variants.

janet_mktg: Perfect. Also want a short JSON snippet we can paste into the docs that annotates which artifact triggered a lead tag (so sales can route webinar leads automatically). Example field: "bench_artifact_id" and a suggested sales label.

tom_runtime: We'll include bench_artifact_id and recommended sales routing tags (e.g., "interested-in-dedicated", "plg-trial", "webinar-lead"). We'll run two sweeps: a coldstart-only (fresh instance) and a short steady-state (2m @ qps=3) so you can show both first-request UX and stable throughput.

ali_bench: Running now. Repro command we'll bundle for local run (no autoscaler) and a Docker image. Paste below:
```bash
# local reproduction (no cloud autoscaler)
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY \
  -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:2026-03-01 \
  /app/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant \
    --endpoint https://localhost:8080/v1/generate \
    --payloads /app/payloads/marketing-payloads.json \
    --warmup 20 --duration 60 --concurrency 1
```

ali_bench: And the cloud run command we used for hosted numbers:
```bash
./bench/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant \
  --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --payloads marketing/payloads.json \
  --warmup 30 --duration 120 --concurrency 1 --region us-west1
```

benchbot: benchmark job 1799234575 queued for rwd-gen4-small-quant (tags: webinar, marketing).

devops-bot: note: hosted-prod autoscaler may add variance to first-request numbers. See runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/bench-variance

ali_bench: Uploaded artifacts to s3: https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/1799234575/ (contains CSVs, traces, payloads, Dockerfile, README). Bench_artifact_id: 1799234575. Suggested sales_label: ["webinar-lead","demo-interested","plg-trial"].

janet_mktg: Awesome. Can you paste the 1-line caveat we should use under the slide? Keep it plain english.

tom_runtime: Caveat: "Numbers are measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; actual results may vary by model, workload, and deployment mode (hosted vs Dedicated)."

janet_mktg: Great. One more: any odd trace artifacts or outliers we should call out?

ali_bench: Nothing surprising. We did see a single 5s spike during the coldstart run on quant (trace id: trace-1799234588) due to a node warmup path. We included the raw trace and a condensed snippet in the artifacts folder for transparency.

janet_mktg: Perfect transparency thanks. We'll use the S3 link and the caveat in the slide notes and add the bench_artifact_id to the webinar signup flow so sales gets the label.

tom_runtime: FYI for sales integration: recommend mapping bench_artifact_id to CRM as crm.custom_fields.bench_artifact_id and attach suggested tags.

janet_mktg: Copy. I'll handoff to growth to wire the CRM. Thanks team, will ping if we need smaller JSON fragments for the slide bullets. :tada:
